## Introduction 
In this project we will try to design a strategy that times the return of Apple stock ('AAPL'). For that, we will employ an MLP network that aims to predict whether the future return of AAPL is positive or negative. Based on the predictions from the model, we will later on check how our strategy performs.

Note: *The code is adapted to run on any stock using its Ticker.*

```{python}
# Required packages
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
import keras_tuner as kt
import numpy as np

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import yfinance as yf
```
##  Data and sources
As with any other Deep Learning endeavor, the single most important and necessary ingredient is data. We will retrieve Apple stock price data from Yahoo! Finance using the famous **yfinance** library in Python.


```{python}

```
data = yf.download(tickers="AAPL", start="01-01-1980", end="12-31-2022")
